sentences.scenario: Tell someone what your family did this weekend.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 去过 for the specific weekend outing; analysis corrects it to 去爬山了.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián zǒu guo èrshí yīnglǐ.
sentences.source_note: Analysis distinguishes experience from a specific event and corrects the twenty-mile hiking description.

sentences.chinese: 大女儿只走了一小段路。
sentences.pinyin: Dà nǚ'ér zhǐ zǒu le yì xiǎo duàn lù.
sentences.english_hint: My older daughter only walked a short distance.
sentences.scenario: Explain how far your older daughter walked.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 大女儿去一点 to 大女儿只走了一小段路.

sentences.english_hint: I help my wife clean the house.
sentences.scenario: Describe how you help at home.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 帮忙我的太太 and 洗我们的家 using the analysis's model.

sentences.scenario: Explain how you pay your bills.
sentences.source_note: Repeated 买 for payments; learner successfully repeated this correction near the end.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge yuè huán fángdài.
sentences.english_hint: I make mortgage payments every month.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 每月买房子 to 每个月还房贷; 还 is pronounced huán.

sentences.chinese: 我用工资的百分之二交水电费。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yòng gōngzī de bǎifēnzhī èr jiāo shuǐdiànfèi.
sentences.english_hint: I use two percent of my salary to pay utilities.
sentences.scenario: Explain the utilities share of your budget.
sentences.source_note: Analysis supplies this correction for unclear percentages and 买水电费.

sentences.pinyin: Xià cì wǒ xiǎng qù Zhōngguó.
sentences.english_hint: Next time, I want to go to China.
sentences.scenario: Say where you want your next trip to be.
sentences.source_note: Repeated confusion between 上次 and 下次; analysis includes this China travel plan.

sentences.chinese: 如果护照办好了，我们就去中国旅游。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ hùzhào bàn hǎo le, wǒmen jiù qù Zhōngguó lǚyóu.
sentences.english_hint: If the passport is ready, we'll travel to China.
sentences.scenario: Explain what your China trip depends on.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 做护照 to 办护照 and supplies this conditional travel sentence.

sentences.chinese: 我想从北京坐高铁去上海。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng cóng Běijīng zuò gāotiě qù Shànghǎi.
sentences.english_hint: I want to take the high-speed train from Beijing to Shanghai.
sentences.scenario: Describe your planned route within China.
sentences.source_note: Corrects repeated 我想去高铁 and makes the learner's Beijing-to-Shanghai route reusable.

sentences.pinyin: Qù Běijīng bǐ qù Shànghǎi piányi.
sentences.english_hint: Going to Beijing is cheaper than going to Shanghai.
sentences.scenario: Compare the flight options you discussed.
sentences.source_note: Analysis models this comparison; learner discussed a lower flight quote for Beijing.

sentences.pinyin: Shēnghuófèi yuè lái yuè gāo le.
sentences.source_note: Analysis retains this useful change pattern from the living-cost discussion.

sentences.scenario: Explain a benefit of online banking.
sentences.source_note: Analysis corrects 有方便 to 很方便 and separates convenience from security.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ kàn bu dǒng.
sentences.scenario: Explain your difficulty reading a Chinese book.
sentences.source_note: Analysis replaces 不能读 with 看不懂 to express a comprehension difficulty.
